column3: NASB follows the critical text with the short greeting “Grace to you and peace.” A full-width colon appears in the NASB text.
NASB follows the critical text without “of you”; it ends the verse at “our prayers” and joins “unceasingly” to v. 3.
NASB begins with “constantly,” from v. 2 in the Greek; it renders “remembering” as “bearing in mind,” “endurance” as “steadfastness,” and “hope of our Lord” as “hope in our Lord.”
NASB follows the critical text; “the election of you” is rendered “His choice of you.”
NASB renders “full assurance” as “full conviction” and adds “kind of men” and “proved to be.”
NASB follows the critical text (“an example”).
NASB follows the critical text; it adds “kind of.”
NASB follows the critical text; it renders “heavens” as “heaven” and adds “that is.”
